verdict.rationale: Lambda instances come with preinstalled JupyterLab accessible directly from the Instances page (one-click) and SSH access for connecting external tools like VS Code (docs-3, docs-7, docs-43). However, there's no explicit documentation of a one-step VS Code/Cursor integration (e.g., a 'Remote-SSH' config generator or IDE plugin) — SSH must be manually configured. Missing for 10: explicit one-click IDE (VS Code/Cursor) connection tooling, official docs on Remote-SSH setup, independent hands-on confirmation of ease of IDE connection.
